subject: Request: 27% hosted API discount & multi-year terms — NovaHealth
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@novahealth.com, Tom Wright <tom.wright@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing request — hosted API (volume commit + VPC)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We ran internal modeling with the usage forecasts attached and want to move fast on a committed plan. Short version: NovaHealth is prepared to commit to a three-year, region-locked VPC deployment and a minimum commit that grows each year (see MAAP forecast). In return we need a material unit-rate reduction.

We want to request a 27% off list rate on Hosted API token usage (applies to production generation tokens only) plus an SLA addendum and a straightforward data residency clause. The team has benchmarked inference cost impact and this is important to meet our payer contract economics.

Attached: NovaHealth_MAAP_usage_forecast.xlsx and an outline of desired contract terms. Can you route this for internal approval? We need an answer for procurement by next Friday (7/6).

Appreciate your help — happy to jump on a call if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Sarah Jennings
Head of Platform Partnerships
NovaHealth

--
Attachment: NovaHealth_MAAP_usage_forecast.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 6KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing request — hosted API (volume commit + VPC)

Team,

Forwarding NovaHealth's formal ask — they want 27% off on hosted token pricing in exchange for a 3-year regional VPC commitment and a stepped commit schedule (see forecast). Key facts:
- ARR-equivalent economics look attractive at scale (year 2+).
- They require SLA + residency language; legal will need to weigh in on acceptable wording.
- Procurement needs an answer by 7/6; sales/legal timeline is tight.

Recommendation: escalate to leadership for one-time exec approval of up to 27% off list for this deal because:
1) Strategic customer in payer-adjacent segment — high LTV and good reference potential.
2) Commitment is multi-year with predictable capacity (reduces spot exposure).
3) We can protect economics with minimum committed spend and an annual true-up.

Requested ask from leadership:
- Approve a 27% unit-rate concession on Hosted API generation tokens (production only) for Deal NH-2028-0042.
- Conditions: 3-year term, 12-month prepayment for year 1 (or equivalent security), inclusion of SLA addendum and data residency clause we approve, and legal pre-approval of redlines.

I can provide the usage forecast + modeled unit economics during the leadership call or drop a short deck. Please advise on next steps; procurement timeline is the bottleneck.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request — hosted API (volume commit + VPC)

Karthik — good write-up, thanks. A couple quick points from deal desk perspective:
- The customer is strategic and the multi-year VPC locks in predictable capacity — I agree we should make an exception beyond the standard 20% guideline here.
- Prefer to cap at 25% if possible (keeps precedent manageable), but I'm comfortable recommending up to 27% to leadership if Mina signs off.
- Legal will need to approve the residency/SLA language; if legal pushes back we should be prepared with fallback pricing (22%).

Mina — can you provide executive sign-off (or route to finance/legal) for an exception to standard authorized concession levels? Procurement needs an answer by 7/6; sales is committed to moving quickly on a clean contract.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request — hosted API (volume commit + VPC)

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed the economics and product risks with Ben and legal. I will approve a one-time 27% concession on Hosted API generation token pricing for NovaHealth (Deal NH-2028-0042) subject to the following binding conditions:
1) 3-year committed term with minimum annual spend schedule in contract and an annual true-up clause.
2) Year 1 prepayment or equivalent financial security (letter of credit).
3) Legal must sign off on SLA addendum and data residency language before any final signature.
4) We include a clause for automated rollback to standard pricing if usage drops below 60% of the committed baseline for two consecutive quarters.

Legal: please prepare the redline with those conditions and send to contracts@novahealth.com. Sales: once redlines are in place, coordinate a DocuSign flow to execute before 7/6.

Mina Haddad
VP, Worldwide Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: nova_contract_redlines.docx (Word doc, 12KB)
